missing_value: Empty CSV cell denotes not measured or not estimable; never zero.

units_and_scopes.RMSE: Original sigma7 units; mean of individual-seed RMSE, not ensemble RMSE.
units_and_scopes.RMSE_seed_SD: Sample SD of six initialization results conditional on one fixed chronology; blank for deterministic R=1.
units_and_scopes.RMSE_seed_t_CI95_lower/upper: Copied published marginal Student-t 95% interval over seed RMSE, not temporal or simultaneous confidence. No interval is recalculated.
units_and_scopes.MAE: Mean individual-seed original-unit MAE; deterministic models have one trajectory.
units_and_scopes.sMAPE: Fraction, not percentage. Multiply by100 only for an explicitly percentage-labelled display.
units_and_scopes.coverage90: Fraction averaged over original frozen per-seed intervals; nominal90%. Not posterior adaptive coverage.
units_and_scopes.mean_interval_width90: Original sigma7 units, same frozen intervals as A2.
units_and_scopes.conditional_neural_mean/min/max_rank: Published rank summaries of13 neural systems in six seed-ID vectors conditional on one chronology. No repeated deterministic rows and no new market replicates.
units_and_scopes.display_position_by_RMSE: Ascending display order across16 systems; descriptive only.
units_and_scopes.actual_parameter_count: Frozen predictive network only; SAE auxiliary decoders excluded. Classical comparable counts unmeasured.
units_and_scopes.final_phase_seconds_mean_per_seed/SD/sum: A100 phase wall time includes updates, eval risk and checkpoints; SAE includesAE1,AE2,supervised. Excludes entire HPO, outer controller and final scoring.
units_and_scopes.final_training_peak_allocated_bytes_obse: Process highwater since callers last reset, not isolated model peak. Scope copied per row.
units_and_scopes.full_selection_seconds: Unknown for all models; selected-recipe costs do not reconstruct full search.
units_and_scopes.mean_latency_gpu_median_ms: Mean of six per-seed medians; A100 CUDA-event forward, resident batch1 input,32warmup+100repetitions. Excludes transfer, preprocessing, weight load and service overhead. Not pooled median or95%CI.
units_and_scopes.core_forward_flops_observed_min/max: Observed min/max over three synthetic probes, not universal bounds. Dense matrix+conv algorithmic count,2FLOPs/MAC,B1eval; excludes FFT, activation, norm, pooling, bias and memory. TimesNet probes with initialization weights do not cover all data-dependent routes.
units_and_scopes.pareto_*: Previously published point-estimate fronts among13 neural systems only. No inferential dominance; latency frontier is a separate documentary plot from the same published points.
units_and_scopes.relative_RMSE_degradation_area_*: Copied normalized trapezoidal area of relative RMSE degradation over three severities. Fraction,lower better. Synthetic stressors on13 networks; no classical or external-market results.
units_and_scopes.original_interval_score90: Published mean interval score for original frozen90% intervals, not a classifier calibration metric.
units_and_scopes.MCS_pvalue/retained_90: Exploratory16-system T_R MCS90%,10000circular block14 draws on daily mean individual-seed MSE. Different estimand/family from primary practical RMSE tests; membership is not equivalence.
